tagline: Healthcare-focused real estate investment trust owning and operating medical office and outpatient facilities
hero_kpi_rationale: Master KPI of the REIT sector representing rental revenues generated by medical property leases, a fundamental element of shareholder value creation

risks.title: Negative impact from Prospect Medical bankruptcy
risks.score_rationale: The risk is explicitly cited in the document as having negatively impacted the company's results. Prospect Medical's bankruptcy directly affects rental revenues and cash flow, constituting an existential threat to the REIT's financial stability.

risks.title: Dependence on affiliated health systems
risks.score_rationale: The document highlights significant exposure to the viability of tenant health systems, with potential revenue concentration. Insolvency or financial difficulties of major tenants could severely impact rental revenues.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and IT intrusion risk
risks.score_rationale: Although not explicitly detailed in the provided excerpt, operational risks related to IT system dependence for REIT operations constitute a growing threat to business continuity.

risks.title: Fixed rent increases below inflation
risks.score_rationale: The document clearly indicates that 96% of leases offer fixed rent escalations versus only 4% tied to CPI. With a weighted average remaining lease term of 4.4 years, fixed increases risk failing to cover inflation, compressing margins.

risks.title: Illiquidity of real estate investments
risks.score_rationale: Real estate properties are inherently illiquid. The document explicitly mentions that the company may be unable to sell strategically targeted properties, limiting financial flexibility.

risks.title: Loss of key personnel
risks.score_rationale: A recurring risk in REITs, but less immediate than financial or credit risks. Loss of experienced management could affect investment strategy and operational execution.

risks.title: Failure to qualify as a REIT
risks.score_rationale: Loss of REIT status would result in double taxation at both corporate and shareholder levels, with major tax and valuation consequences. This is an existential risk to the REIT business model.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence in the 10-K
